trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide U-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-calculated interior angle of 110 degrees; depth of notch is roughly 15% of the total vertical lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical irregular serrations; right lobe trailing edge features high-amplitude jagged peaks (approximately 5-8 pixel depth) whereas the left lobe features higher-frequency, lower-amplitude micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature transitioning to a steep convex sweep at the distal tips; trailing edge maintains a downward slope relative to the horizontal midline of the notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast yellowish-white pixel clusters (likely barnacles) located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes; density is higher on the terminal edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive colonization of sessile organisms at both fluke tips; prominent irregular indentation (likely predatory or mechanical trauma) visible on the upper trailing edge of the right lobe near the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniform low-intensity (near-black) dorsal pigmentation across the entire visible surface area, contrasting sharply with the foam and white-pixel clusters at the tips.
